claims.text: Steve designed Oakminder as a productivity AI agent meant to handle task details directly from notifications, including snoozing and completing reminders.
Rather than relying on a chat interface, Oakminder uses voice input to capture reminders quickly while on the move.
Its architectural setup coordinates actions between the phone interface and the backend.
The app covers features spanning voice interaction, agendas, progress tracking, snoozing, alarms, and actionable notifications.
